scripts.preinstall: node -e "const ua=process.env.npm_config_user_agent||''; if(!ua.includes('pnpm')){console.error('This repository uses pnpm. Install dependencies with: pnpm install'); process.exit(1)}"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./apps/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
